# Dependency and Asset Manifest

| Package / asset | Verified version or source | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap | `^5.3.3` | grid, forms, modal, collapse, offcanvas, tooltip |
| jQuery | `^3.7.1` | Select2/DataTables/legacy hooks |
| Alpine | `^3.4.2` | Breeze-derived components |
| Lucide | `^1.47.0` | icon rendering |
| Flatpickr | `^4.6.13` | date inputs |
| Select2 Bootstrap 5 theme | `^1.3.0`; Select2 CDN `4.1.0-rc.0` | enhanced selects |
| SweetAlert2 | `^11.12.1` | confirmations and alerts |
| laravel-datatables-vite | `^0.5.2` | Vite/DataTables integration |
| Yajra DataTables / Buttons | PHP `^13.0` | server-side tables/exports |
| Owned visual assets | `public/assets/logo_small.png`, `logo_square.png`, possibly `bizlite-icon-900x900.png`, `loading.gif` | transfer only if licensed/owned |

`pdfMake` is referenced for one export pathway but not verified as loaded; it is intentionally not a required dependency.
